paperTitle: SIB Game: A Games for Change Platform for Sustainable Development Goals
centralContribution: This paper introduces SIB Game, an innovative Games for Change (G4C) platform designed to engage players in tackling socio-environmental and health challenges aligned with the 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). It provides a structured summary of its development and early validation, emphasizing its role in fostering critical thinking, collaboration, and behavior change towards sustainability through interactive, challenge-based learning and gamified mechanics.

elements.name: SIB Game Platform for SDG Engagement
elements.description: Introduction of SIB Game, an innovative Games for Change (G4C) platform designed to engage players in tackling socio-environmental and health challenges aligned with the 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), fostering critical thinking, collaboration, and behavior change towards sustainability through interactive, challenge-based learning and gamified mechanics.
elements.justification: This is the central innovation and the primary reason for the paper's existence, directly summarizing the core achievement.

elements.name: SIB Game: Addressing SDG Implementation Gap
elements.description: The paper addresses the challenge of translating theoretical sustainability knowledge into actionable change, particularly regarding the 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), due to low engagement in traditional training and lack of scalable practical tools. It introduces SIB Game, a Games for Change (G4C) platform, as a solution to provide structured, SDG-aligned content and practical engagement for both educational and corporate needs, leveraging gamified mechanics to foster critical thinking and collaborative problem-solving.
elements.justification: Provides the essential context, problem statement, and a concise overview of the proposed solution (SIB Game), serving as a comprehensive summary of the paper's core.
